_comment: Curated metadata, keyed by file name (or path relative to the category folder). Times can be seconds or h:mm:ss. A long scene can carry a "highlight" ({ start, end, note }): a 2-3 minute cut inside it that its tile plays first, with the full sequence a button away. Scenes with "start": null show up as 'no time yet': play the movie, press B at the right moment and the time is filled in (E sets the end). Scene edits made in the app are saved to DATA_DIR/scenes.json and win over this file.

The Dark Knight (2008).mp4.title: The Dark Knight
The Dark Knight (2008).mp4.description: The whole film, with shortcuts to the big set pieces. Starred scenes are the loudest action with the biggest score moments. Times are frame-checked against the 2:32:12 release, where the title smoke starts at 0:00:43; if your copy's studio logos run longer or shorter, shift every time by the difference.

scenes.title: Opening bank heist
scenes.note: From the bat logo in the smoke to the bus pulling away.

highlight.note: The vault, the crew turning on each other, a school bus through the wall, and the Joker unmasked.

scenes.title: Parking garage: Scarecrow and the copycats
Hong Kong extraction
scenes.note: The jump from the IFC tower, the skyhook and the C-130, then Lau delivered to Gordon.

scenes.title: Armored truck chase and the Batpod
scenes.note: Lower Fifth, the Tumbler crash, the Batpod and the truck flip.

highlight.note: "Eject sequence initiated": the Batpod bursts out of the Tumbler, the chase, and the truck flips end over end.
Batman loses his temper, and the Joker makes him choose: Harvey or Rachel.
The bomb goes off in the station, Rachel's last words, the warehouse explosion.

scenes.title: Hospital explosion
scenes.note: One minute, and the whole building comes down. A good subwoofer test.

highlight.note: The detonators are found, the Joker's announcement, and the vote.
SWAT moves in; Batman sees the trap with the sonar and fights his way up.

scenes.title: Ending: a dark knight
scenes.note: Gordon's speech over the final chase, through the title card.

Star Wars Episode I - The Phantom Menace.title: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
Star Wars Episode I - The Phantom Menace.description: The 4K 60 fps edition with the 7.1 mix. Starred: the podrace, the Battle of Naboo and Duel of the Fates. Times are frame-checked against this 2:16:12 copy.

scenes.title: Opening crawl and the Jedi aboard the Trade Federation ship
scenes.note: The crawl, the gas, the droidekas, and the escape down the ventilation shaft.

highlight.note: The crawl and the main theme, then the cruiser arrives at the Trade Federation ship.

scenes.title: Through the planet core in the bongo
scenes.note: "There's always a bigger fish."

scenes.title: Escape from Naboo and the blockade
scenes.note: Out of the Theed hangar, through the blockade, R2 fixes the shield.

scenes.title: Boonta Eve podrace
scenes.note: From the flyover of the arena to Anakin carried off by the crowd: the grid, the stall, Tusken Raiders, Sebulba, the finish.

highlight.note: "Start your engines": the grid fires up, Anakin stalls, then launches after the pack.

scenes.title: Darth Maul ambushes Qui-Gon on Tatooine
The Battle of Naboo begins
scenes.note: The Gungan army rises out of the swamp, the shields go up, the droid army unfolds.

highlight.note: The droid army unfolds on the plain, the Gungan shield goes up, the droids march through it.

scenes.title: Duel of the Fates
scenes.note: Maul in the hangar, the generator room duel, the space battle and the control ship, intercut to Qui-Gon's last words.

highlight.note: Maul in the hangar, Anakin's fighter takes off, and the duel moves onto the catwalks.

Iron Man 2 (2010).mp4.title: Iron Man 2
Iron Man 2 (2010).mp4.description: 4K HDR with the 7.1 mix. Starred: Monaco, the drones turning on the Expo, and the garden fight. Times are frame-checked against this 2:04:37 copy.

scenes.title: Shoot to Thrill: Iron Man drops into the Stark Expo
Monaco: Whiplash on the track
scenes.note: The race, the electric whips, the suitcase suit.

highlight.note: Happy rams Whiplash with the Rolls, the suitcase suit, and the fight on the track.

scenes.title: Birthday party: Iron Man vs. War Machine
Hammer's drones turn on the Expo
scenes.note: War Machine is hijacked, the chase over Flushing Meadows, Black Widow in the hallway.

highlight.note: The drones turn on the crowd, Iron Man saves a boy in an Iron Man mask, and the chase ends in an explosion.

scenes.title: Garden fight: Iron Man and War Machine vs. the drones
scenes.note: Crash-landing in the Japanese garden, the drones close in, Whiplash, the explosion, and the rescue of Pepper.

highlight.note: Whiplash arrives, the crossed repulsor beams, and the drones blow up across the Expo.

Star Wars Episode II - Attack of the Clo.title: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones
Star Wars Episode II - Attack of the Clo.description: 4K HDR with the 6.1 mix (DTS-HD MA, lossless; on a 5.1 system the back-centre channel is shared between the surrounds). Starred: the speeder chase, Obi-Wan vs. Jango Fett, the asteroid field, the Clone War and the duel with Dooku. Times are frame-checked against this 2:22:34 copy.

scenes.title: Opening crawl and the bombing on the landing platform
scenes.note: The crawl, the Naboo cruiser touches down on Coruscant, and the explosion.

scenes.title: Speeder chase through Coruscant
scenes.note: From Obi-Wan's leap through the window after the probe droid to Zam Wesell's death in the alley: the traffic lanes, Anakin's dive, the club.

highlight.note: Anakin's yellow speeder after Zam's, through the traffic lanes and the power couplings.

scenes.title: Obi-Wan vs. Jango Fett on Kamino
scenes.note: In the rain on the landing platform, through Slave I lifting off.

scenes.title: The asteroid field and the seismic charges
scenes.note: Slave I hunts Obi-Wan through the rings of Geonosis. The seismic charges are a moment of silence, then the subwoofer.

scenes.title: The droid factory
scenes.note: Anakin and Padmé on the assembly line: conveyors, presses and crushers, and C-3PO's head on a battle droid.

highlight.note: Padmé's fall onto the conveyor, the presses and the crushers.

scenes.title: The Geonosis arena
scenes.note: The reek, the acklay and the nexu, then two hundred Jedi against the droid army.

highlight.note: The Jedi against the droid army on the arena floor.

scenes.title: Yoda's cavalry: the Clone War begins
scenes.note: The gunships drop into the arena, then the battle on the plain: AT-TEs, walkers and the Trade Federation core ships.

highlight.note: Gunships over the battlefield, the walkers firing, and a core ship hit and coming down.

scenes.title: Count Dooku vs. Obi-Wan, Anakin and Yoda
scenes.note: The hangar duel, Anakin loses his arm, then Yoda.

highlight.note: Yoda arrives, turns back the Force lightning and draws his lightsaber; Dooku escapes.

scenes.title: Ending: the clone army marches
scenes.note: The Imperial March over the clone troopers boarding their ships, then the wedding on Naboo.

The Odyssey (2026).mp4.title: The Odyssey
The Odyssey (2026).mp4.description: Christopher Nolan's Homer, 4K HDR with the 5.1 mix (DTS-HD MA, lossless). The story is told out of order: Odysseus tells it to Calypso and later to Penelope, and Menelaus tells Telemachus about Troy. Starred: the Cyclops, the Trojan horse, the giants, Charybdis and Scylla, Zeus's storm and the fight in the hall. Times are frame-checked against this 2:52:35 copy.

scenes.title: The Cyclops
scenes.note: Landing on the island, the cave and its cheese, the boulder, the night the Cyclops eats two men, the burning stake, and the run for the ships.

highlight.note: Out of the cave with the flock, the blinded Cyclops after them, and the dash to the ships.

scenes.title: The Trojan horse
scenes.note: Menelaus tells Telemachus: days inside the horse, Sinon's "gift for Athena", the Trojans hauling it in, the moonless night and the gates.

highlight.note: Sinon presents the horse, the Trojans haul it in to chanting, and the crowd falls silent.

scenes.title: Storms and the giants
scenes.note: Storm after storm, then the Laestrygonians: a giant child, its parents, and the run back to the ships.

highlight.note: The giants arrive, the retreat through the trees to the beach, and the rowing out under attack.

scenes.title: Circe's island
scenes.note: The landing party at Circe's house, the men turned into animals, and Odysseus against Circe.

highlight.note: The feast, Circe's humming, and the men turned into pigs.

scenes.title: Into Hades
scenes.note: The trench of blood, Sinon's ghost, Agamemnon, Tiresias's prophecy, and the unburied crew.

highlight.note: Tiresias's prophecy, then the unburied crew comes clamouring out of the dark.

scenes.title: The Sirens
scenes.note: Odysseus tied to the mast. The sound of the world falls away while he hears the song.

scenes.title: Charybdis and Scylla
scenes.note: Steering down the whirlpool's slope and out the other side, then the monster in the cliffs takes six men.

scenes.title: Zeus's storm
scenes.note: The calm that lures them out onto the sea, then the storm that sinks the ship.

scenes.title: The fall of Troy, as Odysseus tells it
scenes.note: Still in disguise, Odysseus tells Penelope what happened once the gates were open.

highlight.note: The army pours into the city and the fight becomes a massacre.

scenes.title: The bow and the suitors
scenes.note: Penelope's challenge, the suitors who can't string the bow, the beggar who can, and the fight in the hall.

highlight.note: The bow is strung, the shot through the axes on a thunderclap, and the fight begins.

scenes.title: Ending: chasing the escaping sun
scenes.note: Odysseus and Penelope, and the bard's song over the end.

Dolby/Unfold.mp4.description: Crystal panels unfold into a mirrored tunnel, ending on the Dolby Atmos logo.

DTS/Orchestra.mp4.description: Swirls of golden light and an orchestral score spread around the room, ending on the DTS-HD logo.

DTS/Out of the Box.mp4.title: DTS:X — Out of the Box
DTS/Out of the Box.mp4.description: A glowing cube bursts apart and its pieces scatter through space, ending on the DTS:X logo.

THX/Eclipse.mp4.title: THX — Eclipse
THX/Eclipse.mp4.description: The Deep Note from start to finish. An eclipse opens into an iris as the chord builds, and the subwoofer joins for the climax.

THX/Genesis.mp4.title: THX — Genesis
THX/Genesis.mp4.description: Water, a neon city at night and a futuristic lab, ending with the Deep Note.
